justifiedBaselineUpdates.reason: Reproducibility fix, not a content change: the hash above was originally captured from a working-tree copy with LF line endings; core.autocrlf=true (no .gitattributes override) means a genuinely clean `git clone`/`git worktree add` checkout of this exact commit materializes this file with CRLF line endings instead, hashing differently even though the byte content of every line is identical. Re-captured from `git worktree add --detach <dir> <commit>` so the recorded hash matches what any clean checkout on this platform actually produces.
justifiedBaselineUpdates.diffSummary: Hash only; no source change. Same root cause could recur for any frozen file if it is ever git-added while its working-tree copy has LF endings — verify frozen-surface hashes from a clean worktree checkout, not the authoring working tree.

justifiedBaselineUpdates.reason: M1.1.3 (Codex-verified): <Environment preset="apartment"> fetched lebombo_1k.hdr from a remote CDN (raw.githack.com/pmndrs/drei-assets); a failed/blocked fetch rejected past Suspense into no error boundary, taking down the whole /builder route with Next.js's fatal page-load error. Fix removes the remote dependency at its root: swaps the drei Environment import/element for a new local, procedurally-generated environment (src/components/builder/LocalEnvironment.jsx, using three's bundled RoomEnvironment + PMREMGenerator, zero network calls) wrapped in a new defensive error boundary (src/components/builder/SceneEnhancementBoundary.jsx) so any future non-essential scene enhancement failure can't take the configurator down either. No layout, panel, camera, base lighting, or existing behavior changed. Full diff verified via `git diff -- src/app/builder/page.jsx` before updating this hash.
justifiedBaselineUpdates.diffSummary: +5/-2 lines: Environment import replaced by LocalEnvironment + SceneEnhancementBoundary imports; <Environment preset="apartment" /> replaced by <SceneEnhancementBoundary><LocalEnvironment /></SceneEnhancementBoundary>.
